definitions.explanation: Indicates that a message has been read by the recipient. Originally a feature of LINE messaging app, now widely used across various messaging platforms.

examples.japanese: ⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{既読|きどく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{既読|きどく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついて→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It shows as read but there's no reply.

examples.japanese: {既読|きどく}⟦スルー→スルー：11575_suruu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.notes: {既読|きどく}スルー = read and ignored

examples.japanese: {既読|きどく}⟦{無視|むし}→無視：13473_mushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I wish they would stop ignoring my messages after reading them.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {既|き} (already) + {読|どく} (reading) = already read

ORIGIN: This term became widely used with the LINE messaging app's read receipt feature, which shows "{既読|きどく}" when a message has been seen.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{既読|きどく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ - to show as read
・{既読|きどく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to become read (status changes to read)
・{既読|きどく}⟦スルー→スルー：11575_suruu⟧ - to leave someone on read, to read but not reply
・{既読|きどく}⟦{無視|むし}→無視：13473_mushi⟧ - to ignore after reading

ANTONYM:
・⟦{未読|みどく}→未読：07733_midoku⟧ - unread

CULTURAL NOTE: The {既読|きどく}⟦スルー→スルー：11575_suruu⟧ phenomenon has become a social issue in Japan, especially among young people, as ignoring messages after reading them is seen as rude or can cause anxiety about the relationship.
